text:
alexa: Quick heads-up — scheduling a partner sync re: driver/CUDA/ROCm gating and external comms. Goal: agree on pinned stack for marketplace images + hotfix process. Meeting tmrw 9am PT? :calendar:

mike: +1. Can we get a proposed pinlist before the call? I have partner asking about CUDA12.3 vs 12.4.

sara: I'll dump current telemetry and recent regressions into the doc. Quick note: we saw perf drop on M60 with CUDA12.4 in canary.

jenny-biz: Partners want a clear rollback window and press messaging template. Also IP/legal wants us to avoid promising timelines.

alexa: here's the current proposed pin set (from infra): `CUDA=12.3`, `NVIDIA driver=535.86`, `ROCm=5.5`. open to change. /cc @ops-bot to attach CI matrix.

ops-bot: attached: matrix-report-3312345678.csv (simulated) — failures: 6/120, regressions flagged on T4 and M60.

mike: T4 regressions are high priority. Can we create a canary lane for partner A only?

sara: yes — staging canary + partner A traffic. I'll add auto-rollback on >3% error in 10m.

jenny-biz: For comms: draft two messages: one for marketplace listing (technical notes) and one customer-facing advisory. I'll put templates in the drive.

alexa: Action items:
- sara: add canary lane + telemetry alerts (due EOD)
- mike: confirm partner A test matrix + agree rollback SLA (due tmrw)
- jenny-biz: draft comms templates (due tmrw noon)
- infra: hold release until signoff

mike: Also suggest we publish "compatibility gate" checklist:
```
- verify kernel ABI
- run perf smoke (latency p50/p95)
- run model fidelity testset
- smoke on partner hardware
- update marketplace metadata
```

sara: noted. I'll add kernel ABI tests to the pipeline. FYI, ROCm 5.6 shows improved perf on MI100 but had a syscall regression in 5.5->5.6.

jenny-biz: For press: no mention of "bug" wording, use "compatibility update" + links to rolling notes. Legal OK with that framing.

alexa: timeline: aim to freeze pins by Fri COB, hotfix window next Wed (if needed). If regressions persist, fallback models will be enabled automatically.

mike: Ping @sara and @alexa — want to run a quick triage before the call? 30m now?

sara: I'm in. starting meeting in #hangouts. :phone: 

alexa: joining. thanks everyone. :thumbsup: 

ops-bot: deploy-check triggered by sara at 3312345689 — canary lane created for partner A.

mike: great, will monitor dashboards. I'll upload partner test results to the doc after run.

jenny-biz: uploaded comms v1: link https://drive.redwood/integrations/compat-comms-v1

alexa: saved. We'll confirm final pins after today's run and lock for Fri if green.
